review.posthog_relevance: Reduces unnecessary Slack API calls and log noise in the Slack App integration by skipping placeholder user identities and treating missing email as a warning rather than an exception.
review.reason: The change adds a constant and guard to skip placeholder Slack user IDs, returns early if the ID matches the placeholder, and changes exception logging to a warning for missing email. These are localized maintenance and behavior corrections within the Slack App integration, not broader systemic improvements.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the frequency of placeholder identities and missing emails, which is not established by the code alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assigned; score requires a conservative grouping and a score, not a tier. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a constant and a guard to skip placeholder Slack user IDs.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents the Slack integration from attempting to resolve a non-existent user identity, avoiding unnecessary API calls and potential failures when Slack messages are posted by bots or hidden identities.

observations.behavior: Adds an early return and comment when the Slack user ID matches the placeholder.
observations.posthog_connection: Short-circuits the user resolution and feedback posting workflow for placeholder identities, preventing the system from treating a bot or hidden identity as a real PostHog user.

observations.behavior: Changes exception logging to a warning for missing email, while retaining feedback posting.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces log noise and exception handling overhead for a recoverable, expected condition (missing email) while still allowing feedback to be posted if requested.
